methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,971 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S. and Canada with approximately 208 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2021 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and omnichannel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability and price using digital tools. Further, online and omnichannel retailers continue to focus on delivery services, as customers are increasingly seeking faster, guaranteed delivery times, including same-day and next-day fulfillment, low-price or free shipping, and convenient pick-up options, including curbside pick-up, in-store pick-up, and buy online pick-up in-store (BOPIS) lockers, and we must make investments to keep up with our customers’ evolving shopping preferences.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'For purchases made on Lowes.com, customers may pick up their purchase in-store at the customer service desk, curbside pick-up, or touchless lockers, or have their purchase delivered to their home or business.'. The stock trades at 14.8x FY22E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,971 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S. and Canada with approximately 208 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.00x; -2% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.75; conservative 2yr +48%.

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2023-01-27) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.00x (0.2% downside to Bear $202 / +113.8% upside to Bull $433) | Adj composite 2.22 vs market 1.47: gap +0.75 [UNDERVALUED] | -2% above the EPP floor $206 (15x FY22E $13.72) | Conservative 2-yr case: +47.6% total (+23.8%/yr) | At 14.8x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $268 sits at or below the BASE case; comps +2.2% in Q3 FY22, forward sales +0.8-1.8% (FY22 sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
